title: Chapter 1436
text:
The Emperor Skysplitter Blade and the Psionic Wave Emitter had already been strengthened by Han Xiao's [Transcending Divine Equipment] to the 'Divine Equipment' level. Just a single attack was no different from an ultimate move that could destroy the world!

Facing the terrified gaze of the Secret Tree King, the Emperor Skysplitter Blade stabbed out. The huge blade rapidly enlarged in his eyes, and he could not react in time.

Boom!

The huge blade pressed against the Secret Tree King and suddenly pierced into the spatial wall of the secondary dimension, creating countless cracks like cracked porcelain. The power of this strike was transmitted to the entire secondary dimension, and it had already exceeded the upper limit of what it could withstand. The entire shadow space exploded, and all the darkness dissipated. Countless spatial storms flowed in reverse.

However, the Secret Tree King was not sent flying. Instead, he was firmly stuck to the tip of the blade by the strong gravitational field. At the same time, the Supreme Heavenly Venerate extended a finger and pressed it against the Secret Tree King's body. The invisible power of the Spacetime Amber flowed along his finger and started to make amber on the Secret Tree King's body.

The soul link of the Spacetime Amber had already reached the fifth level in the past ten years. There was no need to use the amber itself to touch the target. One only needed to touch the target to activate the seal. This meant that the Spacetime Amber did not need to be carried around anymore. It could be placed anywhere.

At the same time, due to the (Energy Base-God of All Machines) talent of the Transcendent Mechanic, his basic form of existence was not limited to his physical body. The Mechanical Deity that he fused with was also his main body. This meant that if he touched the target with the Mechanical Deity's body, he would also satisfy the judgment of the Spacetime Amber!

The Secret Tree King was fixed on the spot by a bunch of Universal Treasure-level control devices. The extremely lethal psionic waves rushed into his body along the blade, crushing large amounts of cells. The energy in his body was suppressed by the energy seal of the Transcendent Grade, and he could not even self-destruct. Furthermore, he did not dare to self-destruct in front of a Transcendent. That was truly 'courting death'.

Black Star's speed was too fast, exceeding the Beyond Grade A level. He could not react much at all, as though he had fallen into such a state the moment he regained his senses.

"How can anyone break through this limit? This kind of power can't be grasped by a single individual! "

The Secret Tree King panicked, his face pale.

He did not expect that a Tree God-level Super would appear in this civilization. It had only been more than ten years, so how could there be such a huge change?

The World Tree had been growing for countless years. Other than the Ancestral Tree King, the other four tree kings had all changed positions. Although the Ancestral Tree King had the power to dismiss the other Tree Kings, he rarely used it. Generally speaking, unless the Tree King died, he would not change his candidate.

However, the Tree Kings could revive, so why would they still die … That was the problem. Some Tree Kings had tried to break through to a higher level, but all of them died without exception. They thought that they could revive through the World Tree, but after dying during their advancement, their Information Form would directly leave the connection of the World Tree. They would not be able to revive and would die completely. After failing time and time again, with the precedent, basically no one tried to advance anymore.

In their eyes, the Transcendent Area was a natural chasm that an individual could not cross. It was the limit of an individual life form. Only by using other methods could they temporarily step into a higher level. The descent of the Tree God was one way.

This idea was not strange. Having a powerful Extraordinary power system did not mean that one could become stronger endlessly. Although many civilizations liked to confuse the difference between the two, these were two different concepts. Be it the World Tree experts or the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations, they all had this common sense and also acknowledged the existence of individual limits … The difference was that the standards of individual strength were different. Until now, no one had discovered the true absolute limit, so there were different definitions.

"I have to break free from his control, or else …"

The Secret Tree King made up his mind and crazily activated the cell reactor. Ignoring the damage to his cells, he forcefully squeezed out all his magic power and fiercely attacked the energy seal. After struggling without caring about the consequences, he finally loosened the control field.

"There's still a chance to escape!"

The Secret Tree King was overjoyed. Just as he was about to accumulate his strength to burst out and break through Han Xiao's control, the Tree King Power in his body suddenly flowed out like a flood and was sucked away by an invisible force. His body suddenly went limp, and his accumulation of strength was interrupted. A sense of weakness spread throughout his body.

"My Tree King Crown!"

He suddenly raised his eyes and looked in the direction of the Ancestral Tree King in shock.

The Ancestral Tree King's figure was already wrapped in a rapidly expanding green light. It was like a huge egg, and a huge figure was faintly discernible inside. The energy fluctuations were rising steadily.

How could the Secret Tree King not recognize this scene? The Ancestral Tree King had already activated the Tree God's Descent, instantly taking back his Tree King Crown and sucking away his power. It was obvious that he had abandoned him and decisively stopped his losses. Not only did he have no intention of saving him, he even destroyed his hope of escaping!

"No!"

The Secret Tree King's eyes widened in shock.

Han Xiao sensed the change in the Ancestral Tree King and turned around to take a look. His heart skipped a beat, and he looked down at the Secret Tree King.

"We agreed on a two-person world. I didn't expect you to secretly pull a third party … Alright, sleep well. I'll play with him again."

As soon as he said that, he suddenly moved his finger, and the Spacetime Amber formed!

Deng!

The Secret Tree King's face was frozen in shock, as though he could not believe that he was taken down so easily. His entire body was frozen in the amber.

"Got it!"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

The Secret Tree King was very strong among the Beyond Grade As, but he could not do anything in his hands. Although there was a element of surprise, the main reason was that the difference in strength was too huge. The Secret Tree King did not have the time to use any methods before dying.

Compared to the various schemes he had used to seal the Heart Tree King, sealing an even stronger Secret Tree King this time was much easier. Although it was not as simple as not having a Beyond Grade A fighting a Calamity Grade, it was still a crushing victory.

The next moment, a channel opened at the tip of the mechanical finger, and the Secret Tree King's amber was swallowed into its body.

After doing this, Han Xiao officially turned around and faced the rapidly expanding green light of the Ancestral Tree King, which was also emitting the pressure of a Transcendent.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He could roughly guess why the Secret Tree King fled so decisively and was so afraid of him.

"So that's how it is. The World Tree also has the power of a Transcendent. The Secret Tree King doesn't have any fighting spirit because he has seen this power before … Maybe the Transcendent Grade of the World Tree has already unlocked the ability to kill Information Forms. Therefore, in his opinion, regardless of whether he self-destructs or not, I can directly attack him at the Information Form level and kill him completely. I can crack the mechanism of the World Tree and deprive him of his eternal life. That's why the Secret Tree King is so afraid of me …"

Han Xiaoxin calculated and immediately became vigilant.

"If that's the case, doesn't that mean that the Transcendent Grade of the World Tree can also threaten me?"

Without another word, he fired at the green light. He did not have the habit of waiting for others to transform.

At this moment, the green light suddenly exploded, and a huge tree palm with intertwined roots extended out from the strong light. Green light surged out from the palm and turned into a barrier, blocking the torrential firepower of the mechanical army. It did not budge even after enduring the continuous impact. It was indestructible.

The figure of the Ancestral Tree King had already disappeared, and in its place was a huge treant. Its entire body was glowing green, and countless World Tree Roots were wrapped around its body. It was as if it was a vine armor woven from the World Tree Roots. Many small roots grew out from various parts of its body like dancing snakes, tearing open spatial rifts and absorbing the matter and energy on the other end of the passage.

"What is this?"

Han Xiao glanced at the interface. The other party's name was (Tree God (Incomplete)). A large amount of information was filled with question marks. Clearly, its overall level was higher, and its Grade was Transcendent.

"Interesting. The World Tree still has such a method hidden. Why hasn't it used it before …"

Han Xiao frowned and started to have doubts.

In the war in his previous life, the World Tree had never used this method. Logically speaking, since its nest had been attacked, it should have used all its trump cards to stop the enemy. However, even when the three Universal Civilizations blew up the World Tree's main body, the Tree God had never descended.

He had originally thought that the World Tree did not have the individual strength of a Transcendent, but now it seemed that this was not the case. There must be some secrets that he did not understand.

At this moment, a mental signal came from the Tree God. There was no clear content, only chaotic thoughts and strong thirst, like a hungry beast.

"Does this mean that it wants to eat me?"

Han Xiao could sense the meaning behind the Tree God's words, and his heart skipped a beat.

It seemed like this Tree God's thoughts were very chaotic, and there was no rational leader?!

Before he could observe for a while, the Tree God pounced forward and impatiently fought with the Supreme Heavenly Venerate.

Countless World Tree roots wrapped up in green light and flung out time and time again, smashing toward Han Xiao's mechanical body. They were constantly cut off by the Emperor Skysplitter Blade, but new ones quickly grew out.

A machine and a tree, two giant creatures fought in the space storm. Dozens of Mechanical Oracles led their troops to surround the Tree God and fire. Every moment, countless attacks landed on the Tree God's body. However, its HP seemed to be limitless. Not only did the body made of the World Tree roots have extremely high resistance, but it also had extraordinary regeneration ability.

Oathkeeper and Clottey had already dodged far away. The aftermath of the battle between the two Transcendent Grade powers was too terrifying, and they had no room to interfere. They could only follow behind and watch from afar.

"I didn't expect the World Tree to have the strength of a Transcendent. It's actually fighting evenly with Black Star. If they had used it earlier …"

Clottey's eyes widened in shock.

"Can't you tell? This Transcendent doesn't seem to be an individual. The World Tree Civilization must have paid a price to create a Transcendent." Oathkeeper shook his head and analyzed calmly. "Furthermore, he's not evenly matched with Black Star. Look, he's already at a disadvantage."

Due to the incomplete Tree King Crown, the Tree God's Descent this time was not complete, and its combat strength did not reach its peak. After fighting for a while, the Tree God gradually fell into a disadvantage under Han Xiao's fierce attacks. It only relied on its strong flesh to resist the attacks, attacking less and defending more and more.

Han Xiao also felt the weakness of the Tree God, and his heart skipped a beat.

"Although he's a Transcendent, his combat strength doesn't seem to be enough. It should be because of the 'incomplete' suffix. He's not the complete body of the Tree God yet … Could this have something to do with me?"

Han Xiao's thoughts raced. Although he did not know the activation conditions of the Tree God's Descent, when he thought about how one of the requirements was to find Supers of the other four classes as helpers when he advanced to the Transcendent Grade, he had a guess.

"The composition of the five Tree Kings is similar to the requirements for advancing to the Transcendent Grade. Could this be the birth condition of the Tree God? If that's the case, I've sealed the Heart Tree King and the Secret Tree King, so the complete version of the Tree God can't descend? "

Han Xiao felt that it was more and more possible, and he could not help but perk up.

In that case, I've unintentionally weakened the other party's important trump card?!

Great! Let's see who dares to say that I'm unlucky in the future. I'm usually unlucky because I've never failed at critical moments!
